title: Normalized quotient map in tensor degree zero
statement: For every Noetherian scheme T, prime ell, and n, the realization of finiteSheaf T ell n 0 maps to quotientLine T ell n 0 with GeneratorCompatible. No invertibility of ell is assumed. The empty root tuple makes the compatibility premise vacuous.

source.place: Step 2: Existence of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism

proof.text: Apply the comparison unit formula to identify the finite etale coefficient unit after pro-etale pullback.

Realize constant coefficients along scalars; identify extension of the completed coefficient unit with the finite unit by multiplication. Compose with the inverse unit comparison. Its value on a is scalars(a) tensor 1.

proof_origin.place: Step 2: degree-zero multiplication, first root projection, and tensor induction

lean.statement:
theorem tateTensorQuotient_generator_zero
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n 0) ⟶ quotientLine T ell n 0,
      GeneratorCompatible T ell n 0 f
